verses.sloka: स वीक्षमाणः तत्रस्थो मार्गमाणः च मैथिलीम् ।अवेक्षमाणः च महीम् सर्वाम् ताम् अन्ववैक्षत ॥५-१५-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa vīkṣamāṇaḥ tatrastho mārgamāṇaḥ ca maithilīm ।avekṣamāṇaḥ ca mahīm sarvām tām anvavaikṣata ॥5-15-1॥

translations.english: Hanuman looked out from the simsupa tree all around for Mythili scanning the ground below.

verses.sloka: सन्तान कलताभिः च पादपैर् उपशोभिताम् ।दिव्य गन्ध रस उपेताम् सर्वतः समलम्कृताम् ॥५-१५-२॥
verses.transliteration: santāna kalatābhiḥ ca pādapair upaśobhitām ।divya gandha rasa upetām sarvataḥ samalamkṛtām ॥5-15-2॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. It teemed with animals and birds. It was filled with the voices of the cuckoos. It had tall mansions and underground chamber. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). Ashoka flowers in bloom hung down to the base of the tree as if to take away the grief of the onlookers. The blossoms of the Karnikara and kimsuka brightened the whole grove.

verses.sloka: ताम् स नन्दन सम्काशाम् मृग पक्षिभिर् आवृताम् ।हर्म्य प्रासाद सम्बाधाम् कोकिल आकुल निह्स्वनाम् ॥५-१५-३॥
verses.transliteration: tām sa nandana samkāśām mṛga pakṣibhir āvṛtām ।harmya prāsāda sambādhām kokila ākula nihsvanām ॥5-15-3॥

translations.hindi: गुरुओं द्वारा सुशिक्षित श्रोलक्ष्मण के ज्येष्ठश्राता श्रीरामचन्द्रजी की पत्नी सीता, जब ऐसे कष्ट भोग रही हँ, तब दूसरों का कहना ही क्या है? हा ! काल के प्रभाव को उल्लंघन करना ( अथवा काल के प्रभाव से बचना.) सर्वथा हुस्साच्य है

verses.sloka: कान्चन उत्पल पद्माभिः वापीभिः उपशोभिताम् ।बह्व आसन कुथा उपेताम् बहु भूमि गृह आयुताम् ॥५-१५-४॥
verses.transliteration: kāncana utpala padmābhiḥ vāpībhiḥ upaśobhitām ।bahva āsana kuthā upetām bahu bhūmi gṛha āyutām ॥5-15-4॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. verses.sloka: सर्व ऋतु कुसुमैः रम्यैः फलवद्भिः च पादपैः ।पुष्पितानाम् अशोकानाम् श्रिया सूर्य उदय प्रभाम् ॥५-१५-५॥
verses.transliteration: sarva ṛtu kusumaiḥ ramyaiḥ phalavadbhiḥ ca pādapaiḥ ।puṣpitānām aśokānām śriyā sūrya udaya prabhām ॥5-15-5॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. verses.sloka: प्रदीप्ताम् इव तत्रस्थो मारुतिः समुदैक्षत ।निष्पत्र शाखाम् विहगैः क्रियमाणाम् इव असकृत् ॥५-१५-६॥
verses.transliteration: pradīptām iva tatrastho mārutiḥ samudaikṣata ।niṣpatra śākhām vihagaiḥ kriyamāṇām iva asakṛt ॥5-15-6॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. verses.sloka: विनिष्पतद्भिः शतशः चित्रैः पुष्प अवतम्सकैः ।आमूल पुष्प निचितैर् अशोकैः शोक नाशनैः ॥५-१५-७॥
verses.transliteration: viniṣpatadbhiḥ śataśaḥ citraiḥ puṣpa avatamsakaiḥ ।āmūla puṣpa nicitair aśokaiḥ śoka nāśanaiḥ ॥5-15-7॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. translations.hindi: श्रस्या हेतोविशालाक्ष्या हतो वाली महाबलः । रावणप्रतिमो वीये कबन्धशच निपातितः

verses.sloka: पुष्प भार अतिभारैः च स्पृशद्भिर् इव मेदिनीम् ।कर्णिकारैः कुसुमितैः किम्शुकैः च सुपुष्पितैः ॥५-१५-८॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa bhāra atibhāraiḥ ca spṛśadbhir iva medinīm ।karṇikāraiḥ kusumitaiḥ kimśukaiḥ ca supuṣpitaiḥ ॥5-15-8॥

translations.english: Hanuman surveyed from the Simsupa tree the Ashoka grove of trees full of fine fragrance. It looked welldecorated like the Nandana garden of Indra. There were golden lilies and lotuses in the lakes, enchanting couches with rich coverings and trees full of blossoms of all seasons and fruits in abundance With the Ashoka tree shedding showers of flowers from time to time the place shone with the splendour of Sunrise. It glittered like inflamed fire. The Ashoka tree had hundreds of colourful birds on the branches. It appeared as if it had branches without leaves which made them look like earornaments (of the grove). verses.sloka: स देशः प्रभया तेषाम् प्रदीप्त इव सर्वतः ।पुम्नागाः सप्त पर्णाः च चम्पक उद्दालकाः तथा ॥५-१५-९॥
verses.transliteration: sa deśaḥ prabhayā teṣām pradīpta iva sarvataḥ ।pumnāgāḥ sapta parṇāḥ ca campaka uddālakāḥ tathā ॥5-15-9॥

translations.english: The grove shone bright as if it were inflamed fire with beautiful trees like purnaga, saptaparna, champak and uddalaka in full bloom.

verses.sloka: विवृद्ध मूला बहवः शोभन्ते स्म सुपुष्पिताः ।शात कुम्भ निभाः केचित् केचिद् अग्नि शिख उपमाः ॥५-१५-१०॥
verses.transliteration: vivṛddha mūlā bahavaḥ śobhante sma supuṣpitāḥ ।śāta kumbha nibhāḥ kecit kecid agni śikha upamāḥ ॥5-15-10॥

translations.english: There were thousands of ashoka trees some of which shone like gold, others like the flames of fire and some dark as collyrium.
translations.hindi: इन्हीं के लिए श्रीरामचंद्रजी ने अग्निशिखा की तरह चमचमाते ब्राणों' से जनस्थान-निवासी भयंकर कर्म करने वाले चौदह हजार राक्षसों को माराः था ।।॥। खरश्च निहतः संख्ये त्रिशिराश्च निपातितः । दूषणश्च महातेजा रामेण विदितात्मना

verses.sloka: नील अन्जन निभाः केचित् तत्र अशोकाः सहस्रशः ।नन्दनम् विविध उद्यानम् चित्रम् चैत्ररथम् यथा ॥५-१५-११॥
verses.transliteration: nīla anjana nibhāḥ kecit tatra aśokāḥ sahasraśaḥ ।nandanam vividha udyānam citram caitraratham yathā ॥5-15-11॥

translations.english: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷
translations.hindi: इन्हीं के पीछे दुर्लभ वानरों का राज्य, जिसका पालन वालि करता था, लोकमान्य सुग्रीव को मिला

verses.sloka: अतिवृत्तम् इव अचिन्त्यम् दिव्यम् रम्यम् श्रिया वृतम् ।द्वितीयम् इव च आकाशम् पुष्प ज्योतिर् गण आयुतम् ॥५-१५-१२॥
verses.transliteration: ativṛttam iva acintyam divyam ramyam śriyā vṛtam ।dvitīyam iva ca ākāśam puṣpa jyotir gaṇa āyutam ॥5-15-12॥

translations.english: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷

verses.sloka: पुष्प रत्न शतैः चित्रम् पन्चमम् सागरम् यथा ।सर्व ऋतु पुष्पैर् निचितम् पादपैर् मधु गन्धिभिः  ॥५-१५-१३॥
verses.transliteration: puṣpa ratna śataiḥ citram pancamam sāgaram yathā ।sarva ṛtu puṣpair nicitam pādapair madhu gandhibhiḥ  ॥5-15-13॥

translations.english: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷
translations.hindi: मेरी समझ में तो यदि श्रीरामचंद्रजी इस देवी के लिए, केवल यहः पृथ्वी ही नहीं, बल्कि समस्त लोकों को भी उलट दे तो भी उनका ऐसा करना: उचित ही होगा

verses.sloka: नाना निनादैः उद्यानम् रम्यम् मृग गणैर् द्विजैः ।अनेक गन्ध प्रवहम् पुण्य गन्धम् मनो रमम् ॥५-१५-१४॥
verses.transliteration: nānā ninādaiḥ udyānam ramyam mṛga gaṇair dvijaiḥ ।aneka gandha pravaham puṇya gandham mano ramam ॥5-15-14॥

translations.english: The grove with different types of gardens spread over looked like the Nandana garden of Indra and Chaitraratha garden of Kubera. It surpassed every other garden. It was unimaginable in splendour. It was divine and delightful filled with the radiance of countless varieties of blossoms shining like stars, like a second firmament. It was like another ocean filled with precious gems of flowers. It had trees with flowers of honeyscented fragrance. Sounds of animals and birds filled the air. It was pleasing to the heart with various divine fragrances wafted (by the breeze)৷৷

verses.sloka: शैल इन्द्रम् इव गन्ध आढ्यम् द्वितीयम् गन्ध मादनम् ।अशोक वनिकायाम् तु तस्याम् वानर पुम्गवः ॥५-१५-१५॥
verses.transliteration: śaila indram iva gandha āḍhyam dvitīyam gandha mādanam ।aśoka vanikāyām tu tasyām vānara pumgavaḥ ॥5-15-15॥

translations.english: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि धर्मात्मा महात्मा जनक की यह सुता सीता, पातिब्रत ष्म का निर्वाह करने में पूणं रूप से दृढ़ हैं

verses.sloka: स ददर्श अविदूरस्थम् चैत्य प्रासादम् ऊर्जितम् ।मध्ये स्तम्भ सहस्रेण स्थितम् कैलास पाण्डुरम् ॥५-१५-१६॥
verses.transliteration: sa dadarśa avidūrastham caitya prāsādam ūrjitam ।madhye stambha sahasreṇa sthitam kailāsa pāṇḍuram ॥5-15-16॥

translations.english: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
translations.hindi: पद्मरेण्‌ की तरह खेती की घूल से धूसरित, हल की नोंक से जुते हुए खेत से यहद पृथिवी को फोड़ कर निकली थी

verses.sloka: प्रवाल कृत सोपानम् तप्त कान्चन वेदिकम् ।मुष्णन्तम् इव चक्षूम्षि द्योतमानम् इव श्रिया ॥५-१५-१७॥
verses.transliteration: pravāla kṛta sopānam tapta kāncana vedikam ।muṣṇantam iva cakṣūmṣi dyotamānam iva śriyā ॥5-15-17॥

translations.english: The monkey leader saw a lofty templelike structure in the midst of the Ashoka grove which was highly fragrant and appeared like another indescribable structure that stood on a thousand pillars like another Gandhamadana mountain. It gleamed white like mount Kailasa. Its stairs were paved with corals. The altars were made of brightly polished gold. This structure glowing with brilliance was as if stealing the eyes. It looked white with light and lofty as though scratching the sky.
translations.hindi: और बड़े पराक्रमी श्रेष्ठस्वभाव वाले भ्रौर युद्ध में कभी पीठ न दिखाने बाले महाराज दशरथ की महायशस्विनी जेठी पुत्रबधू है

verses.sloka: विमलम् प्राम्शु भावत्वाद् उल्लिखन्तम् इव अम्बरम् ।ततो मलिन सम्वीताम् राक्षसीभिः समावृताम्  ॥५-१५-१८॥
verses.transliteration: vimalam prāmśu bhāvatvād ullikhantam iva ambaram ।tato malina samvītām rākṣasībhiḥ samāvṛtām  ॥5-15-18॥

translations.english: Then he beheld a lady surrounded by female demons. Clad in soiled clothes she looked dejected, emaciated through fasting and was sighing repeatedly. She appeared thin and pale like the crescent Moon at the beginning of the bright fortnight.
translations.hindi: प्रोर धर्मात्मा, कृतज्ञ तथा प्रसिद्ध पुरुष श्रौरामचन्द्रजी की यह प्यारी पत्नी है । सो इस समय यह ब्रेचारी, राक्षसियों के वश में ग्रा पड़ी हें

verses.sloka: उपवास कृशाम् दीनाम् निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ।ददर्श शुक्ल पक्ष आदौ चन्द्र रेखाम् इव अमलाम् ॥५-१५-१९॥
verses.transliteration: upavāsa kṛśām dīnām nihśvasantīm punaḥ punaḥ ।dadarśa śukla pakṣa ādau candra rekhām iva amalām ॥5-15-19॥

translations.english: Then he beheld a lady surrounded by female demons. Clad in soiled clothes she looked dejected, emaciated through fasting and was sighing repeatedly. She appeared thin and pale like the crescent Moon at the beginning of the bright fortnight.

verses.sloka: मन्द प्रख्यायमानेन रूपेण रुचिर प्रभाम् ।पिनद्धाम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-२०॥
verses.transliteration: manda prakhyāyamānena rūpeṇa rucira prabhām ।pinaddhām dhūma jālena śikhām iva vibhāvasoḥ ॥5-15-20॥

translations.english: Her form was faintly recognisable. She had a lovely radiance on account of her beautiful form. She looked like the tip of burning fire engulfed in a cloud of smoke.

verses.sloka: पीतेन एकेन सम्वीताम् क्लिष्टेन उत्तम वाससा ।सपन्काम् अनलम्काराम् विपद्माम् इव पद्मिनीम् ॥५-१५-२१॥
verses.transliteration: pītena ekena samvītām kliṣṭena uttama vāsasā ।sapankām analamkārām vipadmām iva padminīm ॥5-15-21॥

translations.english: She was wearing an excellent single yellow cloth which was soiled. Unadorned, she looked like a muddy lotuspond bereft of lotuses.

verses.sloka: व्रीडिताम् दुह्ख सम्तप्ताम् परिम्लानाम् तपस्विनीम् ।ग्रहेण अन्गारकेण एव पीडिताम् इव रोहिणीम् ॥५-१५-२२॥
verses.transliteration: vrīḍitām duhkha samtaptām parimlānām tapasvinīm ।graheṇa angārakeṇa eva pīḍitām iva rohiṇīm ॥5-15-22॥

translations.english: She was bashful, tormented with agony, dejected with a withered look. She appeared like the star Rohini oppressed by planet Mars.

verses.sloka: अश्रु पूर्ण मुखीम् दीनाम् कृशाम् अननशेन च ।शोक ध्यान पराम् दीनाम् नित्यम् दुह्ख परायणाम् ॥५-१५-२३॥
verses.transliteration: aśru pūrṇa mukhīm dīnām kṛśām ananaśena ca ।śoka dhyāna parām dīnām nityam duhkha parāyaṇām ॥5-15-23॥

translations.english: Her face was filled with tears. She looked dejected and emaciated due to fasting. Always plunged in grief, she looked like one meditating in tears.

verses.sloka: प्रियम् जनम् अपश्यन्तीम् पश्यन्तीम् राक्षसी गणम् ।स्व गणेन मृगीम् हीनाम् श्व गण अभिवृताम् इव ॥५-१५-२४॥
verses.transliteration: priyam janam apaśyantīm paśyantīm rākṣasī gaṇam ।sva gaṇena mṛgīm hīnām śva gaṇa abhivṛtām iva ॥5-15-24॥

translations.english: Unable to see her dear kith and kin, she sat guarded by ogresses. She appeared like a doe separated from the herd and encircled by a pack of hounds.

verses.sloka: नील नाग आभया वेण्या जघनम् गतया एकया ।नीलया नीरदापाये वनराज्या महीमिव ॥५-१५-२५॥
verses.transliteration: nīla nāga ābhayā veṇyā jaghanam gatayā ekayā ।nīlayā nīradāpāye vanarājyā mahīmiva ॥5-15-25॥

translations.english: She (from behind) appeared like the earth covered with a range of trees at the end of rainy season with her single long black braid touching her hips looking like a black serpent. She who deserved to be happy and had not experienced worries was burning in grief. (एकवेणी is a trait of a प्रोषितभर्तृका Sita who was forced to stay in Lanka was a प्रोषितभर्तृका नायिका.)

verses.sloka: सुख अर्हाम् दुह्ख सम्तप्ताम् व्यसनानाम् अकोदिवाम् ।ताम् समीक्ष्य विशाल अक्षीम् अधिकम् मलिनाम् कृशाम् ॥५-१५-२६॥
verses.transliteration: sukha arhām duhkha samtaptām vyasanānām akodivām ।tām samīkṣya viśāla akṣīm adhikam malinām kṛśām ॥5-15-26॥

translations.english: After seeing the largeeyed lady worn out and dressed in soiled clothes, Hanuman started deliberating in himself and guessed it was Sita for strong reasons.

verses.sloka: तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादिभिः ।ह्रियमाणा तदा तेन रक्षसा काम रूपिणा ॥५-१५-२७॥
verses.transliteration: tarkayām āsa sītā iti kāraṇaiḥ upapādibhiḥ ।hriyamāṇā tadā tena rakṣasā kāma rūpiṇā ॥5-15-27॥

translations.english: Beholding the form of the largeeyed lady, Hanuman guessed, 'This is similar to the form seen while the demon was kidnapping her'.

verses.sloka: यथा रूपा हि दृष्टा वै तथा रूपा इयम् अन्गना ।पूर्ण चन्द्र आननाम् सुभ्रूम् चारु वृत्त पयो धराम् ॥५-१५-२८॥
verses.transliteration: yathā rūpā hi dṛṣṭā vai tathā rūpā iyam anganā ।pūrṇa candra ānanām subhrūm cāru vṛtta payo dharām ॥5-15-28॥

translations.english: Her face resembled the fullmoon which dispelled the encircling gloom by its radiance. She had a slender waist, beautiful round breasts, shapely eyebrows, red lips, dark hair, and eyes like lotus petals with attractive limbs. She was comparable to Rati, consort of Cupid.

verses.sloka: कुर्वन्तीम् प्रभया देवीम् सर्वा वितिमिरा दिशः ।ताम् नील केशीम् बिम्ब ओष्ठीम् सुमध्याम् सुप्रतिष्ठिताम् ॥५-१५-२९॥
verses.transliteration: kurvantīm prabhayā devīm sarvā vitimirā diśaḥ ।tām nīla keśīm bimba oṣṭhīm sumadhyām supratiṣṭhitām ॥5-15-29॥

translations.english: Her face resembled the fullmoon which dispelled the encircling gloom by its radiance. She had a slender waist, beautiful round breasts, shapely eyebrows, red lips, dark hair, and eyes like lotus petals with attractive limbs. She was comparable to Rati, consort of Cupid.

verses.sloka: सीताम् पद्म पलाश अक्षीम् मन्मथस्य रतिम् यथा ।इष्टाम् सर्वस्य जगतः पूर्ण चन्द्र प्रभाम् इव ॥५-१५-३०॥
verses.transliteration: sītām padma palāśa akṣīm manmathasya ratim yathā ।iṣṭām sarvasya jagataḥ pūrṇa candra prabhām iva ॥5-15-30॥

translations.english: Just as the radiance of the full moon is cherished by all, this lady was liked by every one in this world. With her lovely figure she was seated on the ground like an austere ascetic.

verses.sloka: भूमौ सुतनुम् आसीनाम् नियताम् इव तापसीम् ।निःश्वास बहुलाम् भीरुम् भुजग इन्द्र वधूम् इव ॥५-१५-३१॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmau sutanum āsīnām niyatām iva tāpasīm ।niḥśvāsa bahulām bhīrum bhujaga indra vadhūm iva ॥5-15-31॥

translations.english: The timid lady was hissing (sighing) like the consort of the serpent king, who being caught in a widespread cobweb of grief was looking gloomy.

verses.sloka: शोक जालेन महता विततेन न राजतीम् ।सम्सक्ताम् धूम जालेन शिखाम् इव विभावसोः ॥५-१५-३२॥
verses.transliteration: śoka jālena mahatā vitatena na rājatīm ।samsaktām dhūma jālena śikhām iva vibhāvasoḥ ॥5-15-32॥

translations.english: She was like the flames of fire obscured by smoke. She appeared like the text of Smriti of doubtful meaning, a treasure that has been thrown away

verses.sloka: ताम् स्मृतीम् इव सम्दिघ्दाम् ऋद्धिम् निपतिताम् इव ।विहताम् इव च श्रद्धाम् आशाम् प्रतिहताम् इव ॥५-१५-३३॥
verses.transliteration: tām smṛtīm iva samdighdām ṛddhim nipatitām iva ।vihatām iva ca śraddhām āśām pratihatām iva ॥5-15-33॥

translations.english: She was like faith shattered, hope frustrated, desires blocked by obstacles, success vitiated, fame marred and intellect blurred.

verses.sloka: स उपसर्गाम् यथा सिद्धिम् बुद्धिम् सकलुषाम् इव ।अभूतेन अपवादेन कीर्तिम् निपतिताम् इव ॥५-१५-३४॥
verses.transliteration: sa upasargām yathā siddhim buddhim sakaluṣām iva ।abhūtena apavādena kīrtim nipatitām iva ॥5-15-34॥

translations.english: She appeared like fame besmirched by false allegation. She was pained by the obstruction to meet Rama and emaciated by abduction.

verses.sloka: राम उपरोध व्यथिताम् रक्षो हरण कर्शिताम् ।अबलाम् मृग शाव अक्षीम् वीक्षमाणाम् ततः ततः ॥५-१५-३५॥
verses.transliteration: rāma uparodha vyathitām rakṣo haraṇa karśitām ।abalām mṛga śāva akṣīm vīkṣamāṇām tataḥ tataḥ ॥5-15-35॥

translations.english: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.

verses.sloka: बाष्प अम्बु प्रतिपूर्णेन कृष्ण वक्त्र अक्षि पक्ष्मणा ।वदनेन अप्रसन्नेन निह्श्वसन्तीम् पुनः पुनः ॥५-१५-३६॥
verses.transliteration: bāṣpa ambu pratipūrṇena kṛṣṇa vaktra akṣi pakṣmaṇā ।vadanena aprasannena nihśvasantīm punaḥ punaḥ ॥5-15-36॥

translations.english: The fawneyed lady was looking here and there with her dark, curved eyelashes. Her unhappy face was streaming with tears.

verses.sloka: मल पन्क धराम् दीनाम् मण्डन अर्हाम् अमण्डिताम् ।प्रभाम् नक्षत्र राजस्य काल मेघैः इव आवृताम् ॥५-१५-३७॥
verses.transliteration: mala panka dharām dīnām maṇḍana arhām amaṇḍitām ।prabhām nakṣatra rājasya kāla meghaiḥ iva āvṛtām ॥5-15-37॥

translations.english: Covered with dirt and mud and shorn of adornments even though she deserved them, she looked wretched like the radiance of the Moon muffled by dark clouds.

verses.sloka: तस्य सम्दिदिहे बुद्धिः मुहुः सीताम् निरीक्ष्य तु ।आम्नायानाम् अयोगेन विद्याम् प्रशिथिलाम् इव ॥५-१५-३८॥
verses.transliteration: tasya samdidihe buddhiḥ muhuḥ sītām nirīkṣya tu ।āmnāyānām ayogena vidyām praśithilām iva ॥5-15-38॥

translations.english: Hanuman did recognise Sita after looking at her carefully again and again even as one is able to make out knowledge of shastriclore forgotten with lapse of time and lack of practice.

verses.sloka: दुह्खेन बुबुधे सीताम् हनुमान् अनलम्कृताम् ।सम्स्कारेण यथा हीनाम् वाचम् अर्थ अन्तरम् गताम् ॥५-१५-३९॥
verses.transliteration: duhkhena bubudhe sītām hanumān analamkṛtām ।samskāreṇa yathā hīnām vācam artha antaram gatām ॥5-15-39॥

translations.english: Just as an unclear expression which has undergone certain changes in meaning due to lack of usage over a long period is understood by virtue of previous practice so also Hanuman had difficulty in recognising Sita who was devoid of any decoration.

verses.sloka: ताम् समीक्ष्य विशाल अक्षीम् राज पुत्रीम् अनिन्दिताम् ।तर्कयाम् आस सीता इति कारणैः उपपादयन् ॥५-१५-४०॥
verses.transliteration: tām samīkṣya viśāla akṣīm rāja putrīm aninditām ।tarkayām āsa sītā iti kāraṇaiḥ upapādayan ॥5-15-40॥

translations.english: After close observation of different signs and deliberation with reasons he came to the conclusion that the largeeyed lady is the same blameless princess Sita.

verses.sloka: वैदेह्या यानि च अन्गेषु तदा रामो अन्वकीर्तयत् ।तानि आभरण जालानि गात्र शोभीनि अलक्षयत् ॥५-१५-४१॥
verses.transliteration: vaidehyā yāni ca angeṣu tadā rāmo anvakīrtayat ।tāni ābharaṇa jālāni gātra śobhīni alakṣayat ॥5-15-41॥

translations.english: Hanuman observed the ornaments worn by Vaidehi adding grace to her limbs which Rama had described.They were wellcrafted earrings and wellfit Savdamshtras. He noticed wonderful, variegated ornaments of corals and gems as well as those worn on hands. They were blackened for long wear and Sita had marks of wearing them on her body. (Note: This is a pair ornaments shaped like dog's teeth. It is not known on which part of the body they were worn).

verses.sloka: सुकृतौ कर्ण वेष्टौ च श्व दम्ष्ट्रौ च सुसम्स्थितौ ।मणि विद्रुम चित्राणि हस्तेष्व् आभरणानि च ॥५-१५-४२॥
verses.transliteration: sukṛtau karṇa veṣṭau ca śva damṣṭrau ca susamsthitau ।maṇi vidruma citrāṇi hasteṣv ābharaṇāni ca ॥5-15-42॥

translations.english: Hanuman observed the ornaments worn by Vaidehi adding grace to her limbs which Rama had described.They were wellcrafted earrings and wellfit Savdamshtras. He noticed wonderful, variegated ornaments of corals and gems as well as those worn on hands. They were blackened for long wear and Sita had marks of wearing them on her body. (Note: This is a pair ornaments shaped like dog's teeth. It is not known on which part of the body they were worn).

verses.sloka: श्यामानि चिर युक्तत्वात् तथा सम्स्थानवन्ति च ।तानि एव एतानि मन्ये अहम् यानि रामो अन्वकीर्तयत् ॥५-१५-४३॥
verses.transliteration: śyāmāni cira yuktatvāt tathā samsthānavanti ca ।tāni eva etāni manye aham yāni rāmo anvakīrtayat ॥5-15-43॥

translations.english: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."

verses.sloka: तत्र यानि अवहीनानि तानि अहम् न उपलक्षये ।यानि अस्या न अवहीनानि तानि इमानि न सम्शयः ॥५-१५-४४॥
verses.transliteration: tatra yāni avahīnāni tāni aham na upalakṣaye ।yāni asyā na avahīnāni tāni imāni na samśayaḥ ॥5-15-44॥

translations.english: "I think these ornaments are the same that were described by Rama. Those dropped (by Sita) are not found on her body. These were not dropped.There is no doubt."

verses.sloka: पीतम् कनक पट्ट आभम् स्रस्तम् तद् वसनम् शुभम् ।उत्तरीयम् नग आसक्तम् तदा दृष्टम् प्लवम् गमैः ॥५-१५-४५॥
verses.transliteration: pītam kanaka paṭṭa ābham srastam tad vasanam śubham ।uttarīyam naga āsaktam tadā dṛṣṭam plavam gamaiḥ ॥5-15-45॥

translations.english: "The shining yellow upper garment like a golden cloth was torn. Flung down, it stuck to a tree which the monkeys noticed.

verses.sloka: भूषणानि च मुख्यानि दृष्टानि धरणी तले ।अनया एव अपविद्धानि स्वनवन्ति महान्ति च ॥५-१५-४६॥
verses.transliteration: bhūṣaṇāni ca mukhyāni dṛṣṭāni dharaṇī tale ।anayā eva apaviddhāni svanavanti mahānti ca ॥5-15-46॥

translations.english: "The jingling, choice ornaments were thrown down on the ground.

verses.sloka: इदम् चिर गृहीतत्वाद् वसनम् क्लिष्टवत्तरम् ।तथा हि नूनम् तद् वर्णम् तथा श्रीमद् यथा इतरत् ॥५-१५-४७॥
verses.transliteration: idam cira gṛhītatvād vasanam kliṣṭavattaram ।tathā hi nūnam tad varṇam tathā śrīmad yathā itarat ॥5-15-47॥

translations.english: "This cloth worn long is crumpled. Even then it has retained its shine and looks fresh.

verses.sloka: इयम् कनक वर्ण अन्गी रामस्य महिषी प्रिया ।प्रनष्टा अपि सती यस्य मनसो न प्रणश्यति ॥५-१५-४८॥
verses.transliteration: iyam kanaka varṇa angī rāmasya mahiṣī priyā ।pranaṣṭā api satī yasya manaso na praṇaśyati ॥5-15-48॥

translations.english: "This lady of golden complexion is Rama's beloved queen who does not disappear from his mind, although away.

verses.sloka: इयम् सा यत् कृते रामः चतुर्भिः परितप्यते ।कारुण्येन आनृशम्स्येन शोकेन मदनेन च ॥५-१५-४९॥
verses.transliteration: iyam sā yat kṛte rāmaḥ caturbhiḥ paritapyate ।kāruṇyena ānṛśamsyena śokena madanena ca ॥5-15-49॥

translations.english: "She is that same lady for whom Rama has been passing through compassion, benevolence, grief and passion. He is compassionate considering her a woman, kind and benevolent since she is his dependent, stricken with grief for losing a wife and passionate since she is his beloved.

verses.sloka: स्त्री प्रनष्टा इति कारुण्याद् आश्रिता इति आनृशम्स्यतः ।पत्नी नष्टा इति शोकेन प्रियेति मदनेन च ॥५-१५-५०॥
verses.transliteration: strī pranaṣṭā iti kāruṇyād āśritā iti ānṛśamsyataḥ ।patnī naṣṭā iti śokena priyeti madanena ca ॥5-15-50॥

translations.english: "She is that same lady for whom Rama has been passing through compassion, benevolence, grief and passion. He is compassionate considering her a woman, kind and benevolent since she is his dependent, stricken with grief for losing a wife and passionate since she is his beloved.

verses.sloka: अस्या देव्या यथा रूपम् अन्ग प्रत्यन्ग सौष्ठवम् ।रामस्य च यथा रूपम् तस्य इयम् असित ईक्षणा ॥५-१५-५१॥
verses.transliteration: asyā devyā yathā rūpam anga pratyanga sauṣṭhavam ।rāmasya ca yathā rūpam tasya iyam asita īkṣaṇā ॥5-15-51॥

translations.english: "This blackeyed Sita and her divine, charming body with perfect limbs are a match for Rama's figure.

verses.sloka: अस्या देव्या मनः तस्मिमः तस्य च अस्याम् प्रतिष्ठितम् ।तेन इयम् स च धर्म आत्मा मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवति ॥५-१५-५२॥
verses.transliteration: asyā devyā manaḥ tasmimaḥ tasya ca asyām pratiṣṭhitam ।tena iyam sa ca dharma ātmā muhūrtam api jīvati ॥5-15-52॥

translations.english: "The divine queen's mind is firmly fixed on Rama and his mind, fixed on her. For this reason she and the righteous self (Rama) are able to survive till this moment.

verses.sloka: दुष्करम् कुरुते रामो इमाम् मत्त काशिनीम् ।सीताम् विना महा बाहुः मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवति ॥५-१५-५३॥
verses.transliteration: duṣkaram kurute rāmo imām matta kāśinīm ।sītām vinā mahā bāhuḥ muhūrtam api jīvati ॥5-15-53॥

translations.english: "Lord Rama had accomplished a difficult task in sustaining the body this way without allowing it to sink and perish during separation from her.

verses.sloka: एवम् सीताम् तदा दृष्ट्वा हृष्टः पवन सम्भवः ।जगाम मनसा रामम् प्रशशम्स च तम् प्रभुम् ॥५-१५-५४॥
verses.transliteration: evam sītām tadā dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭaḥ pavana sambhavaḥ ।jagāma manasā rāmam praśaśamsa ca tam prabhum ॥5-15-54॥

translations.english: "Rama, the strongarmed hero has accomplished a difficult task by surviving even for a moment without this Sita who has intoxicating lustre".
